title: Drink water
description: Take a few sips of water and notice the feeling.

title: Open the window
description: Let fresh air in for one minute.

title: Stretch gently
description: Roll your shoulders and take a slow breath.

title: Send a small message
description: Share today's good feeling with someone — even just an emoji.

title: Write down three things
description: What are you grateful for today? Write three things, however small.

title: Name one thing you did
description: What did you complete today? Write it down and let yourself see it.

title: Hold this moment
description: Close your eyes for 30 seconds. Feel how you feel right now and let it settle.
